description: Discussion topics for one Canvas course, with unread counts. Pass course_id as the Canvas course ID or as the course name. Example: "What discussions are open in my Canvas Networking course?"

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, the number Canvas shows for the course, or the course name such as "Networking 1". Ask get_my_courses for the list of IDs and names.
